fact: On 28 November 2024 the 16th meeting of ECOWAS national regulators' focal points on regional roaming concluded in Praia, and validated the progress of Cabo Verde's mobile operators in providing roaming to citizens travelling in the Community with tariffs in line with the regulation.
title: 16TH Meeting of Focal Points of ECOWAS National Regulatory Authorities on the Implementation of Regional Roaming Concludes in Praia, Cabo Verde
publisher: Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)
